nodes.label: DEMO_FMU_MAIN_DIR (shared FMU output directory)
nodes.rationale: One common output directory (${CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/demoFMU) is set once at the FMI demo root and consumed by every FMU subdirectory as COMPONENT_MAIN_DIR and by every driver as a compile definition, so importers can locate exported FMUs at run time without hard-coded paths.
